metric_snapshots_nonneg_ck.name: metric_snapshots_nonneg_ck
metric_snapshots_nonneg_ck.value: "metric_snapshots"."reach" >= 0 and "metric_snapshots"."saves" >= 0 and "metric_snapshots"."shares" >= 0 and "metric_snapshots"."comments" >= 0 and "metric_snapshots"."clicks" >= 0 and "metric_snapshots"."installs" >= 0 and "metric_snapshots"."activations" >= 0

posts_scheduled_at_ck.name: posts_scheduled_at_ck
posts_scheduled_at_ck.value: "posts"."status" not in ('scheduled','publishing','manual_pending') or "posts"."scheduled_at" is not null

product_documents_source_ck.name: product_documents_source_ck
product_documents_source_ck.value: ("product_documents"."kind" <> 'file' or "product_documents"."storage_key" is not null) and ("product_documents"."kind" not in ('url','repo_spec') or "product_documents"."source_url" is not null)
